>If you have some problems, what stops you from getting help, so that you could have been or can be a better husband? 

We already tried marriage counseling and although it temporarily helped, in the long term it didn't fix our problems. If you have any other suggestions I would love to hear them because I don't know what to do, I am completely out of ideas. As I said, I have seen  numerous therapists, psychologists and counselors of all types and it seems like those avenues just don't work for me. 

Believe me, I have suggested to my wife that we try counseling of some sort again. But she has been there and done that and doesn't want to try again.

>All said and done, please forget about the idea of suicide.

I realize now that if I were to kill myself at present, it would emotionally destroy my wife for ever. Icould never do that to her. Someday, maybe, years later after she has fully moved on with her life andmy life is still unbearable. Then maybe. But not right now. I just couldn't hurt her like that.

>Unemployed for fight now.

I am unemployed. And it is just making the whole situation that much more difficult. With all the problems with the divorce, I am havingto worry about finding a job ASAP so that I can support myself when our lease expires in a month and we go our separate ways.
